description: Lists machine, process or filament presets. By default only presets selectable in the UI are returned; intermediate presets that exist only to be inherited from (e.g. fdm_process_common) are filtered out. Names listed here do not show real setting values; use bambu_resolve_preset for that. No side effects.

includeAbstract.description: Whether to include intermediate presets that exist only to be inherited from and cannot be selected in the UI. Defaults to false.

search.description: Filter by a case-insensitive substring of the preset name.

name: bambu_list_presets
title: List presets
